inferenceTimeSeconds.source: Measured 24 Aug 2026 with eval/fullMetricReport.m over the validation split (n=550) on an RTX 3050 6GB laptop GPU: median 0.715 s, mean 1.799 s, p95 13.157 s per case. The median is used because the mean is pulled up by the largest APTOS captures. Covers the whole per-case path a deployment runs, quality gate and preprocessing included, not the forward pass alone. Results: results/20260824_035401_full_metrics_validation. Target-hardware figures will differ; this is a laptop-class GPU.

deferralRate.source: SCENARIO VALUE, NOT THE MEASURED ONE. Retained at 0.10 as a planning figure for a decision policy that can act autonomously. Measured over the full validation split with eval/ablationHarness.m (configuration A10, the shipped pipeline since 31 Aug 2026, n=550, results/20260830_232525_ablation_A1_A5), autonomous coverage is 0.3273 and 370 of 550 cases escalate, so the measured deferral rate is 0.6727 (see measuredDeferralRate). Configuration A12, the agreement-check repair recommended in section 11.6 and not adopted, measures 0.3364. No measured configuration reaches 0.10, so any sweep run at that value models a hypothetical improved policy, not the system as it stands, and must be labelled that way when quoted. This supersedes the 24 Aug 2026 record of 1.00 from zero autonomous coverage, which reflected the escalate-everything defect fixed in 02cebfa, and the 30 Aug 2026 record of 0.7255 from configuration A5, which shipped until A10 was adopted in ad2f120.

referablePrevalence.source: Retained at 0.10 as a screening-population planning value. Deliberately NOT set to the 0.41 referable fraction of the APTOS test split: APTOS is a competition dataset enriched for disease, not a screening cohort, and using its prevalence would badly distort the workload model.

measuredDeferralRate.source: Measured 30 Aug 2026 over the validation split (n=550) with eval/ablationHarness.m configuration A10, the shipped pipeline since its adoption on 31 Aug 2026 in ad2f120, at the frozen operating point. Autonomous coverage 180 of 550, 370 escalated, deferral rate 0.6727. Results: results/20260830_232525_ablation_A1_A5. Supersedes two earlier figures: 1.00 on 24 Aug 2026, taken before the escalate-everything defect was fixed in 02cebfa, and 0.7255 on 30 Aug 2026 from configuration A5, which shipped until A10 was adopted. The model itself never reads this field; sweep_experiments.m reads it so E3 sweeps the shipped pipeline's rate alongside the scenario grid.
